item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 03:10 PM 15 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sirawai, Manukan, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, Katipunan, LeonB.Postigo, Godod, Gutalac, Kalawit, Tampilisan), #LanaoDelSur(Maguing, Kapai, Saguiaran, MarawiCity, Piagapo, Marantao, LumbaBayabao), #Bukidnon(Talakag, Lantapan, CityOfValencia, Maramag, CityOfMalaybalay, ImpasugOng, Cabanglasan, DonCarlos, Kadingilan), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Midsalip, Bayog), #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan), #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan and Carmen) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Bukidnon(Kalilangan, Pangantucan), #LanaoDelNorte(Tagoloan, Pantar), #LanaoDelSur(Bumbaran, Wao), #AgusanDelSur(SanLuis, LaPaz), #ZamboangaDelNorte(SergioOsmeñaSr., Siayan, Sindangan, JoseDalman, Salug, Liloy and Labason) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
